{{recipesummary|category=Soup recipes|servings=6–8|time=35 minutes|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

This recipe for '''beef gravy soup''' is derived from the ''Household Cyclopedia'' of 1881.

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] lean [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
*2 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]s, sliced
*1 pound sliced root [[Cookbook:Vegetable|vegetable]]s, such as [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]]s, [[Cookbook:Turnip|turnip]]s, or [[Cookbook:Radish|radishe]]s
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Broth|beef broth]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Broth|vegetable broth]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste

==Procedure==
#Place the onions and root vegetables in a large stock pot. Add the beef and the beef stock on top. 
#Bring to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring well.  
#When the beef and vegetables look cooked, add the vegetable broth and salt.
#Bring back to a simmer and serve.
